intro.en: Da Pan is a former Hongshan Academy of Sciences member and proud traveling chef who joined Endfield Industries' Specialist Tech Division as an independent.
intro.zh-TW: 大潘出身宏山科學院，離開後以遊歷四方的廚師身分自豪，現以個人身分加入終末地工業特種技術部門。

basic.en: Physical combo of up to 4 hits. While he is the controlled operator, his Final Strike also deals 20 Stagger.
basic.zh-TW: 最多 4 段的物理傷害連擊。作為主控幹員時，重擊會額外造成 20 點失衡。

battle.en: Briefly charges a wok and flips it upward, dealing Physical damage and Lift to the enemy.
battle.zh-TW: 取出鐵鍋短暫蓄力後向上猛翻，對敵人造成物理傷害與擊飛。

combo.en: Trigger: an enemy reaches 4 stacks of Vulnerability. He swings his wok to deal heavy Physical damage and Crush, with bonus damage on this Crush.
combo.zh-TW: 觸發條件：有敵人達到 4 層破防。揮動鐵鍋對敵人造成大量物理傷害與猛擊，且本次猛擊的傷害額外提高。

ultimate.en: Slams his chopping board to forcibly Lift all enemies ahead, follows with a 6-hit Physical slash flurry, then slams them down for heavy Physical damage and forced Knock Down.
ultimate.zh-TW: 猛拍砧板強制擊飛前方範圍內的敵人，接著發動 6 段物理斬擊，最後將所有敵人擊墜，造成大量物理傷害並強制倒地。

talents.en: Consuming 1 stack of Vulnerability grants Da Pan +4% Physical damage dealt (+6% at Promotion II) for 10 s, stacking up to 4 times.
talents.zh-TW: 每消耗 1 層破防後，自身造成的物理傷害 +4%（精英化II 為 +6%），持續 10 秒，最多疊加 4 層。

talents.en: Each enemy hit by the final sequence of CHOP 'N DUNK! grants 1 stack of Prep Ingredients for 20 s, max 1 stack (2 at Promotion III). While active, hitting with a combo skill spends 1 stack to cut cooldown by 40%.
talents.zh-TW: 切絲入鍋！最後一擊每命中一名敵人，獲得 1 層備料狀態，持續 20 秒，最多 1 層（精英化III 為 2 層）。持有期間連攜技命中會消耗 1 層並立即恢復 40% 冷卻時間。

potentials.en: If CHOP 'N DUNK! defeats at least one enemy, Da Pan gains +30% Physical damage for 15 s (does not stack).
potentials.zh-TW: 若切絲入鍋！至少擊敗一名敵人，大潘造成的物理傷害 +30%，持續 15 秒，無法疊加。

potentials.en: Salty or Mild's Prep Ingredients lasts 10 s longer and holds 1 more max stack.
potentials.zh-TW: 嚐嚐鹹淡的備料狀態持續時間 +10 秒，最大疊加層數 +1。

potentials.en: CHOP 'N DUNK! costs 15% less Ultimate Energy.
potentials.zh-TW: 切絲入鍋！所需的終結技能量 -15%。

potentials.en: When FLIP DA WOK! hits only a single enemy, it applies 1 extra stack of Vulnerability, at most once every 45 s.
potentials.zh-TW: 翻鍋！僅命中單個敵人時額外施加 1 層破防，每 45 秒最多觸發一次。
